observations: Photo 0 shows multiple car engines/gearboxes wrapped in plastic (at least two powertrain units visible).
No readable engine code, VIN plate, or brand/model markings are visible in the photo.
No clear evidence of mileage, condition, completeness (starter/alternator/ECU), or whether parts are matched (engine to gearbox) is visible.

claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any readable 2ZR/engine code or Corolla-specific markings.

risks.risk: Engine/gearbox may not actually be 2ZR or may be mismatched (wrong engine code or wrong gearbox type).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the engine block/engine code stamping (2ZR) and the gearbox code/label (or casting number) plus a photo showing both units together with matching codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not verified/worst case: treat as generic used engine+gearbox with unknown code and unknown match.

risks.risk: Condition may be poor (cracked block, seized internals, damaged gearbox) even if it looks intact.
risks.proof: Video clip of a cold start test (if possible) OR compression test results + gearbox oil inspection (metal shavings) and a short run/engagement test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until proven.

risks.risk: Missing components (ECU, wiring harness, starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, drive shafts) that affect installability.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo of included parts (ECU, harness, starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, hoses) with counts.

risks.risk: Completeness of gearbox (transfer/solenoid/TCU parts) and correct gear ratio for the claimed application.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gearbox identification plate and internal inspection points (or gearbox code stamping) and confirmation of gear ratio/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as wrong/uncertain gearbox until code is confirmed.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code stamping showing 2ZR (engine block/casting number) and a close-up of the gearbox code/label.
Video showing the engine and gearbox together with matching identification (same listing) and any visible serial/ID plates.
Compression test results (or start/run video) and gearbox oil condition check (metal shavings).
Photos listing all included accessories/components (ECU, harness, starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, hoses) to confirm completeness.
response.reason: The photo only shows wrapped engines/gearboxes with no readable engine/gearbox codes, so the claimed 2ZR Corolla 2010 identification and condition cannot be verified remotely. Without that, a reliable worst-case price pick from the comparables is not safe.
